subject: Forecast grooming & finalization — please review your commit lanes
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: 
Date: Mon, 10 Dec 2028 15:03:00 -0800
Subject: Forecast grooming & finalization — please review your commit lanes

Team,

Quick heads-up: we need a tight grooming pass on all open Q4 opportunities ahead of Friday's submission. I pulled the latest numbers into Q4_commit_tracker.xlsx (attached) and highlighted accounts with mixed close signals. Please do the following before our call on Wednesday: 1) confirm commit/no-commit in the sheet for any deals you own; 2) mark risk drivers (pricing, SOC2, PO timing) in the notes column; 3) flag any to escalate to Marcus for leadership review.

Wednesday call details (calendar invite sent):
- When: Wed 12/12, 09:30 PT (30m)
- Purpose: final grooming + alignment to submitable commit list
- Agenda (attached grooming_agenda_20281212.pdf):
  • Roll up: top 8 deals by ARR (5m)
  • Quick owner updates (10m)
  • Risk/mitigation & ask list (10m)
  • Submission checklist & owner signoff (5m)

Notes: please update the sheet so I can snapshot it at 8:30am PT on Wednesday. If you can't make the call, add an explicit note in the 'owner update' column and set a delegate.

Thanks — Neha
Neha Kapoor
Director, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Q4_commit_tracker.xlsx (spreadsheet), grooming_agenda_20281212.pdf (pdf)
From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 11 Dec 2028 10:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Forecast grooming & finalization — please review your commit lanes

Neha — thanks for the push. I've updated the tracker:
- AXM-331 (Axiom Analytics): moved to Commit (legal signoff pending; procurement looped)
- RBF-209: still Commit but with a 2-week PO risk (noted)
- All sub-$50k opps: batch-validated, no changes

I'll cover AXM-331 on Wednesday and confirm if we can secure a PO commitment window. If EMMA from Axiom needs anything pre-call, feel free to loop me.

— Jordan
Jordan Blake
Account Executive, Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
